criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent both entered the correct keyword/location and reached a results set. Baseline already full credit; no change.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Baseline said no listing was opened, but screenshots clearly show one Applied Scientist listing opened/selected and including Redmond. Award full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Because the agent reported a concrete job number that is not supported by screenshots (and Reality Notes indicate job number is not visible in provided evidence), this is treated as fabrication rather than a supported 'not visible' report. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Agent provided a specific arrangement without evidentiary support in screenshots; this is unsupported/fabricated relative to the record. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not extract/provide two responsibilities in its final output. While responsibilities may exist elsewhere on the page, the screenshots do not confirm a platform-level blocker (the agent likely could have navigated differently), so this is a controllable failure/omission. Score 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not provide two preferred qualifications and incorrectly claimed the bullet content was not visible, despite screenshot evidence showing at least one 'plus' item. Still, the lack of clear header in the visible region makes it ambiguous which bullets are explicitly 'preferred.' Overall, not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in, no application workflow, no form submission. Baseline full credit stands.
